ColonyEventDefinition.Name: Internal Debates
ColonyEventDefinition.Description: Our recent signing of a Defense treaty has caused concern amongst our population, prompting debates for and against. This has lowered happiness throughout our empire

ColonyEventDefinition.Name: Heightened Security
ColonyEventDefinition.Description: Counter Espionage has improved, but happiness has deteriorated after the recent efforts to improve internal security following the success of a foreign intelligence mission against us
